title: Move-In Charges
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:39 AM
When you display the move-in documents for a business partner or a premise, the documents from the last three months appear.
If no documents exist for this period then the system displays the documents from the last six months.

Once you have entered the move-in, move-out, or move-in/out, you can use the SAP Business Workflows to trigger and monitor
additional business processes.

You can re-process incomplete move-ins and monitor the status of processing. This may be necessary if, for example:
e The meter readings are unavailable
e The budget billing plan cannot be created, or
e The data required to print the welcome letter is incomplete

Move-In Charges

When you save the move-in document, the system posts the move-in charges automatically, provided you have configured the
system accordingly in Customizing under |)*Move-In/Out » Define System Parameters for Move-In and Move-Out.

You can configure the system to post the charges to a contract or contract account. You configure how the system calculates the
charges using the parameters Charge category and Charge schema. In this way, you can, for example, levy a move-in charge

staggered to correspond with the number of contracts.
Reduced Layouts

In Customizing, you can define reduced layouts for the configurable tab on page on the move-in screen to hide some of the data on
the individual tab pages. The layouts can now be stored in the special processing variants for the move-in/out. This enables agents
to process move-ins and move-in/outs more quickly.

Budget Billing

A budget billing amount agreed with the customer is also taken in account if the move-in is entered by the master data generator.
If a budget billing plan cannot be created for a contact in move-in processing then the BudgetBillingPlansFailed event of the
MOVEINDOC BOR object type is triggered.

Activity Log

In Customizing you can configure the system to save the activity log for the move-in. You can then display it on the move-in screen.
To do this choose |}*Extras » Display Activity Log.

Activities
Initial Screen

Based on the data you specified on the initial screen, the system automatically determines which of the following cases applies:

Exists before move-in                                      Is created during move-in
Business partner, contract account, installation | Contract

Business partner, installation                           Contract account, contract
